items.headline: Bottom 10 after Week 10: Toothless Wolverines on list after rivalry loss
items.description: In a season where several big-name programs are struggling, Michigan is the latest to lay an egg.

items.headline: Buckley, Cabana power rushing attack for Western Michigan in 42-14 win over Akron
items.description: — Jalen Buckley dashed for 121 yards and two touchdowns, Cole Cabana added 107 rushing yards and a score, and Western Michigan defeated Akron 42-14 on Tuesday night.

items.headline: CFP 24-team format: What you need to know about the new playoff
items.description: The expanded College Football Playoff is official and begins next season. Here's what you need to know.

items.headline: Western Michigan squares off against Akron in MAC action
items.description: Western Michigan (6-3) at Akron (1-8), Nov. 10 at 7 p.m. EST.

items.headline: Bottom 10 after Week 9: Florida State follies spell doom for Seminoles
items.description: With Mike Norvell gone, the Seminoles slide onto this week's dubious list.

items.headline: Duncan Brune's 91-yard TD rallies Ohio over Akron 28-20
items.description: — Duncan Brune had a 91-yard touchdown run with 3:57 remaining, and Ohio answered Akron’s fourth-quarter rally to beat the Zips 28-20 on Tuesday night.
